scope: A household-object geometry challenge cohort specified before inference, not a random population sample. Three seeds are clustered within each object. Original-versus-original seed variation changes the whole stochastic pipeline; it is context, not an error allowance or a subtraction from quantization error. The intervals are empirical stability intervals from 2,000 stratified object resamples, not population coverage guarantees. Ground-truth 3D reconstruction accuracy is not established. Approximate orthographic rendering is separate from upstream rendering and target-image accuracy. No quality threshold was chosen after seeing results.

mesh_f1_0_1_percent.description: Mesh F1 within 0.1% of reference diagonal (%)

mesh_f1_0_5_percent.description: Mesh F1 within 0.5% of reference diagonal (%)

prepared_image_changed_pixels_percent.description: Preprocessed input pixels with any channel change (%)

measurement_definitions.geometry: Area-weighted surface samples to closest triangles; unsquared Euclidean distances in model units, with normalized percentages relative to the original mesh bounding-box diagonal.
measurement_definitions.color: Absolute differences of red, green, blue channel values in [0,1], converted from stored Idol coefficients; no additional gamma transformation. Foreground is the union of pixels with alpha >= 1/255 in either render. Percentage means 100 times mean absolute channel difference, averaged equally across valid views.
measurement_definitions.silhouette: Intersection divided by union of rendered pixels with alpha >= 0.5; both-empty views are counted and excluded from the appearance mean.
measurement_definitions.render_resolution: 256 pixels square, fixed extent -0.75 to +0.75 model units on each image axis, six orthographic directions. Fixed framing can clip geometry; out-of-frame coverage was not measured for all clouds.
measurement_definitions.prepared_image: Exploratory analysis added during the run. Stored preprocessed images are compared in red, green, blue channels. Mean absolute channel difference is divided by 255; changed pixels have any unequal channel. Percentages are on [0,100].
measurement_definitions.camera: Exploratory analysis added during the run. Shortest circular yaw difference and absolute pitch difference are converted from radians to degrees. Vertical field of view is already in degrees; radius difference is divided by the original radius in model-coordinate units.
measurement_definitions.peak_signal_to_noise_ratio: Raw view reports use decibels and maximum channel value 1. A null value at exactly zero squared error represents an infinite ratio, not a failed measurement.

timing_scope: Generation calls after model loading, including preprocessing, sampling, decoding and PLY writing. Shared workstation, original model loaded before Q8 for each object, no randomized order or controlled isolation. First calls can include kernel initialization. These observations do not establish causal speed gains. PyTorch allocated bytes exclude the graphics context, unused reserved allocations and other processes. Host working-set readings are endpoints, not measured peaks.

relative_latent_error_percent.scope: Exploratory association across complete object means; no causal attribution.

foreground_color_error_percent.scope: Exploratory association across complete object means; no causal attribution.

topology_scope: Exploratory diagnostics of the extracted meshes, not ground-truth topology. Euler characteristic is vertices minus edges plus faces; it is not interpreted as a hole count. Triangle volume is reported only for watertight consistently wound meshes; self-intersections were not checked. Area and volume use squared and cubed model-coordinate units.
